summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent break-in at its national crime database, NCIC. The USDA is also still recovering from a cyber incident. Neither agency has named who did it, and no official source links them. Microsoft blamed its Nov 12 outage on a software bug.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC to check warrants and missing-person records. Reports do not say whether it went down or whether any records were taken or changed. Trump called the report 'not good' on Saturday.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI had not commented publicly as of Saturday. CNN, NBC, AP and Fox cite unnamed sources. No reported link to the September FBI jobs portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident disrupts farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation tools were offline for days. An official expected most systems back Friday, with work over the weekend. He said no personal data was lost. I found no newer update.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat. Staff reset database passwords. As of Friday night USDA had not named an attacker or given a detailed account.

events.title: Microsoft explains Nov 12 global Microsoft 365 outage
events.impact: Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams and Copilot were disrupted for almost 24 hours. Airlines, businesses and government offices were hit. New Saturday: Microsoft gave a fuller cause.
events.stated_cause: Microsoft says a months-old software bug was triggered after Teams traffic moved to Exchange servers that had less capacity. It says the outage was not a cyberattack. No outside source disputes this.

events.title: Iran and US trade strikes near Hormuz; drone claims
events.impact: Iran says it downed a US drone over Hormuz. ABC reports ship attacks in Oct and Nov are the highest since the war began. Bahrain and Kuwait said they intercepted Iranian weapons after US strikes on Qeshm Island.
events.stated_cause: Iran says it is answering US actions. The US calls its strikes defensive. Talks to reopen the Strait are stalled. Iran claims of tankers hitting mines are mostly unverified.

events.title: Bitcoin holds near 60K USD after a week of losses
events.impact: Price checks: CoinGecko 60,498 (24h range 55,298 to 62,087, week -12.5%), Coinbase 60,172 (+2% Saturday evening), Bitget 60,181. Prices agree. A CoinMarketCap page showing 55.8K looked out of date. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Earlier reports tie the drop to the stock selloff and forced selling in crypto futures.

events.title: US stocks fall sharply; Dow and S&P 500 in correction
events.impact: Friday close from last run: Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.28%), S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.93%). US markets are closed until Monday, so no recheck. I found no reports of trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite worry about AI spending, with Nvidia down 14%. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. Federal agencies must fix them. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA says it has evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not link the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 01:11 UTC Nov 22. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Undersea cable fault slows internet in Pakistan
events.impact: Pakistan's telecom authority reported a SEA-ME-WE 5 fault offshore with slow service. I found no new update in this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown and under investigation. Sabotage claims on social media are unverified.

events.title: Xsolla game payment service reports a major outage
events.impact: A forum post says Xsolla's status page showed a major outage in its Pay Station. Steam also had checkout complaints earlier Saturday, but nobody has linked the two. No update found this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Neither Xsolla nor Valve has given a cause in the items I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: USDA officials call theirs a cyberthreat and reset passwords, but have not named an attacker. The FBI has said nothing about the NCIC report, so the cause is unknown. Microsoft blames a software bug for its outage. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the USDA and FBI incidents, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: Level is unchanged. No official link between incidents and no new widespread outage found.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. If you work with police or farm programs, expect delays and check official agency notices. Keep passwords strong and turn on two-step sign-in. Watch for official FBI or USDA updates, and recheck stock prices when markets open Monday.
